<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Vitrinix0 – Ofertas de games</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:wght@400;600;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--y:#FFD60A;--bg:#fff;--fg:#000;--card:#f4f4f1;--line:#e3e3de;--mut:#5c5c57;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#000;--fg:#fff;--card:#161616;--line:#2a2a2a;--mut:#a8a8a2}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#000;--fg:#fff;--card:#161616;--line:#2a2a2a;--mut:#a8a8a2}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque',system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.4}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--y);outline-offset:2px}
header{background:var(--y);color:#000;position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:5}
.bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:12px 16px;max-width:1000px;margin:auto}
.logo{font-weight:800;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.logo i{font-style:normal;background:#000;color:var(--y);padding:0 6px;border-radius:6px}
.wa{background:#000;color:var(--y);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}
main{max-width:1000px;margin:auto;padding:0 16px 48px}
.hero{padding:36px 0 24px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(34px,6vw,60px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:800;max-width:14ch}
.hero p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:14px;max-width:46ch}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:18px}
.p{background:var(--card);border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.img{background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:16px;position:relative;border-bottom:3px solid var(--y)}
.img img{width:100%;max-height:340px;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.tag{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;background:#000;color:var(--y);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:99px}
.b{padding:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex:1}
.b h2{font-size:20px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2}
.old{color:var(--mut);text-decoration:line-through}
.price{font-weight:800;font-size:36px;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1}
.off{display:inline-block;background:var(--y);color:#000;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:8px;margin-left:8px;vertical-align:middle;letter-spacing:0}
.inst{color:var(--mut)}
.buy{margin-top:14px;background:var(--y);color:#000;border-radius:99px;padding:14px;font-weight:800;text-align:center;text-decoration:none;display:block}
.ask{margin-top:8px;text-align:center;color:var(--fg);font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;padding:6px}
footer{text-align:center;color:var(--mut);padding:24px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header><div class="bar">
<span class="logo">Vitrinix<i>0</i></span>
<a class="wa" href="https://wa.me/5598981453819?text=Ol%C3%A1!%20Vim%20pela%20Vitrinix0." target="_blank" rel="noopener">WhatsApp</a>
</div></header>
<main>
<section class="hero">
<h1>Games e consoles em oferta.</h1>
<p>Compre pelo botão em cada produto ou tire dúvidas direto no WhatsApp.</p>
</section>
<section class="grid">
<article class="p">
<div class="img"><span class="tag">Black Friday</span><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
